Class GollekInferenceService

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.agent.core.inference.GollekInferenceService
@ApplicationScoped public class GollekInferenceService extends Object
Shared inference service for all Wayang agents. Provides a simplified interface to the Gollek SDK for inference requests.

This service is injected into agent executors via CDI and handles:

  • Provider selection and fallback
  • Request/response mapping
  • Error handling and retry logic
  • Performance tracking
  • Streaming inference (via GollekSdk.streamCompletion)
  • MCP tool discovery and injection

    • inferWithToolLoop

      public AgentInferenceResponse inferWithToolLoop(AgentInferenceRequest request)
      Perform inference with a ReAct-style tool execution loop.

      Flow:

      1. Send messages + tools to LLM
      2. If LLM returns tool_calls → execute each tool via ToolRegistry
      3. Append assistant message (with tool_calls) + tool result messages
      4. Re-call LLM with updated messages
      5. Repeat until LLM returns a STOP finish_reason or max iterations reached
      Parameters:
      request - Agent inference request (with tools and maxToolIterations)
      Returns:
      Agent inference response with tool execution audit trail

    • inferStream

      public io.smallrye.mutiny.Multi<tech.kayys.gollek.spi.stream.StreamChunk> inferStream(AgentInferenceRequest request)
      Perform streaming inference. Returns a reactive Multi of StreamChunk objects that can be consumed as they arrive.

      This is useful for real-time UI updates, progressive rendering, and scenarios where low latency to first token matters.

      Parameters:
      request - Agent inference request
      Returns:
      Multi stream of chunks

    • discoverEnabledMcpServers

      public List<String> discoverEnabledMcpServers()
      Discover enabled MCP servers from the Gollek SDK. The actual MCP tool execution is handled by the inference engine at request time when MCP servers are registered. This method returns the list of enabled server names so they can be included in request metadata for the engine to activate.
      Returns:
      list of enabled MCP server names
